newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Mathomo buys Tonclin.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Mathomo buys Tonclin.

text.p: South Africa's black-owned Mathomo Group Ltd retailer said on Sunday it had bought the entire issued share capital of Tonclin Investment Holdings (Pty) Ltd for 24.6 million rand, subject to adjustment.

A statement said the ownership profile of Mathomo -- a large bloc of its shares is held by the Mineworkers Investment Company (Pty) Ltd -- meant it was well-placed to help its new acquisition get business from school boards.
Tonclin holds Eldons Group, a retailer and wholesaler of educational, commercial and general stationery.
"(Mathomo) is also well positioned to expand the group's existing customer base to include government, quasi-government organisations and large commercial corporations," the statement said.
Of the total purchase price, 12.5 million rand will be settled by the issue of 5.5 million new Mathomo ordinary shares at an average price of 2.25 rand per share.

"The purchase consideration is subject to adjustment, depending on, inter alia, the pre-tax profit of Tonclin for the period October 1, 1996 to September 30, 1997. The minimum purchase price is 14 million rand and the maximum is 27.87 million rand," the statement said.
